subject.title: fix(release): candidate smoke rejects valid core package manifests

question: Does the observed Parallels acceptance evidence cover the intended multi-package release artifact and the fallback for manifests without a dedicated dependency list?
rationale: Tests establish the intended argument construction, but release acceptance depends on the actual packaged artifact layout and Parallels execution path; the protected maintainer label requires a human release-owner decision.

options.title: Require live candidate proof
options.body: Request a redacted terminal transcript from a real multi-package candidate acceptance run that shows the corrected dependency selection and successful Parallels smoke.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression tests and existing artifact-contract review while explicitly accepting the remaining release-path uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live candidate proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted terminal transcript from a real multi-package candidate acceptance run that shows the corrected dependency selection and successful Parallels smoke.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows direct ownership of the changed release-candidate and Parallels smoke path.
